Module com.tasktopia
Package ai

Class ParsedTask

java.lang.Object
ai.ParsedTask
public class ParsedTask extends Object
Data-transfer object (DTO) that represents a task parsed from a raw AI response.

Instances are populated by Gson when deserialising the JSON returned by the AI API inside TaskExtractor, so all fields are intentionally public and non-final to allow direct field injection.

Example JSON structure mapped to this class:


 {
   "title":       "Doctor appointment",
   "description": "Annual check-up at the GP",
   "date":        "2025-06-15",
   "time":        "09:30",
   "category": {
     "type":  "built_in",
     "value": "HEALTH"
   },
   "priority": "HIGH"
 }

  • Field Details

    • title

      public String title
      The short title of the task as identified by the AI. May be null if the AI could not determine a title.

    • description

      public String description
      An optional longer description of the task. May be null.

    • date

      public String date
      The due date in ISO-8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd), e.g. "2025-06-15". May be null; TaskExtractor falls back to the current date/time when this field is absent.

    • time

      public String time
      The due time in ISO-8601 format (HH:mm or HH:mm:ss), May be null; used together with date to form a LocalDateTime.

    • category

      public ParsedCategory category
      The category associated with the task, encapsulating both the type (built_in / custom) and the category value. May be null if the AI did not identify a category.

    • priority

      public String priority
      The priority level of the task as a string (e.g. "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"). This value is mapped to Task.Priority by TaskExtractor. May be null.
